split_rule.train_coverage_anchors: canonical pairs with lower operand 0 or upper operand 9
split_rule.remaining_arithmetic: SHA-256 rank: first 10 dev, next 10 eval_main, remaining train
split_rule.copy_domain: values 0..99; canonical, one-zero, two-zero spellings share value family
split_rule.copy: SHA-256 rank: first 70 train, next 15 dev_copy, last 15 eval_regression

order: both panels format 100% and dev_copy accuracy >=90%

acceptance.scope: in-domain arithmetic and copy normalization baseline

comparison_hypothesis: From the same qualified SFT weights, report DPO/RLVR changes on unseen families with copy retention; no positive-effect requirement.
reward_definition: exact correct + registered format_reward; reward labels use train only
sampling_baseline: majority canonical integer among N samples; tie earliest; oracle never used to select
budget_matching: Evaluation greedy arms have same protocol; sampling-only spends N times generations. Training and rollout budgets differ and are reported, no method superiority claim.
